svg.title: Local matching can help or hurt the same item pair
svg.desc: Vector DA motivation diagram. Corrected the Student j fourth-step conditional probability from 0.050 to 0.500. Other labels, scores, rankings, layout, typography and gradients are unchanged. Values are illustrative, not measured experimental results.

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif
